ambient_events: The burner ticks as it cools, then stops.
Glass touches glass behind the counter, deliberate and unhurried.
Something in a stoppered bottle changes colour on its own and nobody looks up.
The extraction fan in the wall kicks on, coughs, and pulls the sharp smell out of the room for a while.
A pencil scratches. The board by the door gets a new number and the old one gets a line through it.
The shutter rails creak as the building shifts in the heat.
description: One long counter of scarred steel splits the room, and everything worth anything is on the far side of it. Behind the counter: a balance under a glass hood, a rack of reagent bottles with hand-inked labels, and a burner that has scorched a black halo into the wall behind it. The air is sharp with something that makes the back of your throat itch. A sheet pinned by the door lists what a grade is worth this week, corrected three times in pencil.

window.description: A shopfront pane onto Main Street, kept just clean enough to trade through. Whatever the weather is doing out there, it's doing it in plain view.
window.name: the shopfront window

name: The Assay Counter
